# 4 real-cost active counter-measure decisions (0 free buffs; every decision targets specific entropy dimensions).

# 1. Monetary & Silver Stabilization (counters Dimension 2; 10-year cooldown)
oe_ent_dec_currency_reform = {
    decision_category = country_specific_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_ent_decision_visible = yes
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 220
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_cd_currency }
        OR = {
            inflation >= 0.04
            oe_ent_idx_ge_25 = yes
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:nobles } }
    option = {
        name = oe_ent_dec_currency_reform.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -220
            add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
            add_inflation = inflation_mild_bonus
            set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cd_currency months = 120 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ent_mod_currency_reform years = 10 mode = replace }
            oe_ent_add_index = { amt = -8 }
            oe_ent_recalc_cache = yes
        }
    }
}
